value.rationale: For the smallest nonabelian card-shuffling group, the sharp total-variation optimum over coherent control quantifies exactly when an unavoidable sign/parity mode becomes the only residual obstacle. The optimal phase makes both three-cycle probabilities uniform and improves the fixed-horizon envelope from classical order e^{-γt} to e^{-2γt} with a proved exact coefficient 1/4. The result is a complete natural fixed-time design classification, not an arbitrary finite table or an unoptimized specialization. Scope is limited to unbounded control and the six-state model; it does not claim a fixed-control global speedup or trace-distance advantage.
